title: The repository content audit and the forensic inventory: retired content refused, dispositions applied
note: RC1-RC9 remove, one at a time, each rule of tools/repo_content_audit.py -- the retired roots, the removed paths, the retired output names, the area classification, the allowance's scope, the stale-allowance report, the protocol identifiers as exact strings, an import matched by its retired package, not only by an inventoried module -- and each is killed by the audit's own reintroduction controls. RI1-RI3 remove the forensic inventory's applied, disposition and classification checks. RC10-RC11 plant retired content into the learned-model substrate -- an import of a retired module, inside a function body so nothing fails at import time, and a machine-mode name -- and the substrate's boundary tests refuse each. This file spells retired names on purpose; tools/repo_content_audit.py allows it by name. RC12-RC13: an import inside a function, and a module named to the built-in __import__, are still dependencies.

mutations.name: RC6_a_stale_allowance_is_kept_quietly

mutations.name: RC7_a_protocol_identifier_excuses_its_neighbourhood
